info.name: API documentation
info.description:
# 📄 Get started here

This collection contains APIs for Inpections Project.

## Authentication

`it is required to access the API. Authorization token can be get by login API, steps are their to cover how to get it, and the relevant error codes.`

### Authentication error response

If an API key is missing, malformed, or invalid, you will receive an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response code.

item.name: User

request.description:
## Login

Authenticates a user and returns a bearer token to be used in subsequent API requests.

---

### Endpoint

`POST https://sectorial-be.senaei.app/api/inspection/login`

---

### Headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| `Accept-Language` | `en` | Specifies the response language. |

---

### Request Body

Sent as **multipart/form-data**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `email` | string | Yes | The user's registered email address. |
| `password` | string | Yes | The user's password. |

---

### Response

Returns a JSON object on successful authentication.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Indicates whether the login was successful. |
| `token` | string | Bearer token to be used for authenticated requests. |
| `user` | object | Details of the authenticated user. |

#### User Object

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Unique user identifier (ULID). |
| `username` | string | The user's username. |
| `first_name` | string | User's first name. |
| `last_name` | string | User's last name. |
| `national_id` | string | User's national ID number. |
| `email` | string | User's email address. |
| `mobile` | string | User's mobile number. |
| `entity` | string | The entity the user belongs to. |
| `date_of_birth` | string | User's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `language` | string | Preferred language of the user. |
| `last_login_at` | string | Timestamp of the user's last login. |

---

### Post-Response Behavior

After a successful response, the `token` value is automatically saved to the **`token`** environment variable, making it available for use in subsequent authenticated requests.

request.description:
Logs out the currently authenticated user by invalidating their active session or token.

**Authentication:** Requires a valid `token` set in the environment (used for authorization).

**Request Body:** None required.

**Headers:**
- `Accept-Language: en` — Specifies the language for the response.

**Responses:**

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| 200 OK | The user has been successfully logged out. Returns `{"success": true, "message": "Logged out successfully."}` |

## Profile

Retrieves the authenticated user's profile information, including personal details, account status, and synchronization metadata.

---

### Authentication

This endpoint requires a Bearer token. The token is stored in the `{{token}}` environment variable and must be included in the request headers:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

 ```

---

### Request

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| **Method** | `GET` |
| **URL** | `https://sectorial-be.senaei.app/api/inspection/profile` |
| **Body** | None |

---

### Response

**Status:** `200 OK`

Returns a JSON object containing a `user` key with the authenticated user's profile data.

#### Response Structure

``` json
{
  "user": { ... }
}

 ```

#### `user` Object Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Unique identifier for the user (ULID format). |
| `old_id` | `string | null` | Legacy identifier from a previous system, if applicable. |
| `username` | `string` | The user's login username. |
| `first_name` | `string` | The user's first name. |
| `last_name` | `string` | The user's last name. |
| `national_id` | `string` | The user's national identification number. |
| `email` | `string` | The user's email address. |
| `mobile` | `string` | The user's mobile phone number. |
| `entity` | `string` | The organizational entity the user belongs to (e.g., `mim`). |
| `date_of_birth` | `string` | The user's date of birth in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. |
| `language` | `string` | The user's preferred language code (e.g., `en`). |
| `email_verified_at` | `string | null` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email was verified, or `null` if not verified. |
| `mobile_verified_at` | `string | null` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the mobile number was verified, or `null` if not verified. |
| `blocked_at` | `string | null` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the account was blocked, or `null` if not blocked. |
| `disabled_at` | `string | null` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the account was disabled, or `null` if not disabled. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user account was created. |
| `updated_at` | `string` | ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update to the user's profile. |
| `last_login_at` | `string | null` | Timestamp of the user's most recent login (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format). |
| `ndb_synched_at` | `string | null` | ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful sync with the NDB system, or `null` if never synced. |
| `ndb_last_ops_at` | `string | null` | ISO 8601 timestamp of the last NDB operation, or `null` if no operations have occurred. |

#### Example Response

``` json
{
  "user": {
    "id": "01j5bqa5bb04jdqa0y8rc97sf9",
    "old_id": null,
    "username": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "first_name": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "last_name": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "national_id": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "email": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "mobile": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "entity": "mim",
    "date_of_birth": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "language": "en",
    "email_verified_at": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "mobile_verified_at": null,
    "blocked_at": null,
    "disabled_at": null,
    "created_at": "<redacted-sensitive-value>",
    "updated_at": "2026-06-11T19:40:04.000000Z",
    "last_login_at": "2026-06-11 22:40:04",
    "ndb_synched_at": null,
    "ndb_last_ops_at": null
  }
}

 ```

## 🔐 Forgot Password API (Send Reset Code)

### 📌 Endpoint

```
POST /api/inspection/forgot-password

 ```

---

### 📖 Description

This API sends a **6-digit password reset code** to the staff member’s registered email address. The code is valid for **10 minutes**.

---

### 🔐 Authentication

❌ Not required

---

### 📥 Request Body (JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| email | string | Yes | Staff registered email address | [<redacted-email>](https://null) |

---

### 📌 Example Request

```
{  "email": "<redacted-email>"}

 ```

---

### 📤 Success Response (200 OK)

```
{  "success": true,  "message": "Password reset code sent successfully."}

 ```

---

### ❌ Error Response (404 Not Found)

Returned when no staff account exists with the provided email.

```
{  "success": false,  "message": "No account found with this email."}

 ```

---

### ❌ Validation Error (422 Unprocessable Entity)

```
{  "message": "The email field is required.",  "errors": {    "email": [      "The email field is required."    ]  }}

 ```

request.description:
## Get All Regulations

Retrieves a list of all regulations from the inspection module. The response includes full regulation details such as metadata, issuing authorities, associated documents, and detailed regulation items.

---

### Authentication

This request requires a bearer token. The token is read from the `{{token}}` environment variable and must be set before sending the request.

---

### Response Structure

Returns a JSON object with the following top-level field:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array | List of regulation objects |

#### Regulation Object

Each object in the `data` array contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Unique identifier of the regulation |
| `name` | string | Name of the regulation |
| `number` | string | Official regulation number |
| `issue_date` | string (datetime) | Date the regulation was issued |
| `status` | boolean | Whether the regulation is currently active |
| `issuing_authorities` | array | List of issuing authorities (each with `value` and `label`) |
| `documents` | array | Documents associated with the regulation |
| `items` | array | Detailed regulation items (see below) |
| `created_at` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the regulation was created |

#### Regulation Item Object

Each object in the `items` array contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Unique identifier of the item |
| `type` | object | Item type with `value` and `label` fields |
| `entity_notification` | boolean | Whether entity notification is enabled |
| `geographical_location` | string | Geographical location associated with the item |
| `<redacted-sensitive-value>istrative_name` | object | Administrative name with `value` and `label` fields |
| `name` | string | Name of the regulation item |
| `appeared_in_self_assessment` | boolean | Whether the item appears in self-assessment |
| `report_kind` | object | Report kind with `value` and `label` fields |
| `description` | string | Detailed description of the item |
| `approval_option` | object | Approval option with `value` and `label` fields |
| `rejection_option` | object | Rejection option with `value` and `label` fields |
| `status` | object | Item status with `value` and `label` fields |
| `attachment_mode` | object | Attachment mode with `value` and `label` fields |
| `is_mandatory_for_inspector` | boolean | Whether this item is mandatory for inspectors |
| `report_types` | array | List of report types, each with `value` and `label` |
| `associated_reports` | array | Associated reports, each with `value` and `label` |
| `violations` | array | List of violations linked to this item |
| `created_at` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the item was created |

response.name: Successful Response

request.description:
## Get a Regulation

Retrieves detailed information about a specific regulation by its unique identifier.

### Path Variables

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `regulationId` | The unique ID of the regulation to retrieve. |

### Authentication

This request requires a Bearer token passed via the `token` variable:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

 ```

### Response

Returns a `data` object containing the regulation's full details.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Unique identifier of the regulation. |
| `name` | string | Name of the regulation. |
| `number` | string | Regulation number. |
| `issue_date` | string | Date the regulation was issued (format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`). |
| `status` | boolean | Whether the regulation is currently active. |
| `issuing_authorities` | array | List of authorities that issued the regulation, each with a `value` and `label`. |
| `documents` | array | Attached documents related to the regulation. |
| `items` | array | List of regulation items (notes, requirements, etc.). Each item includes type, <redacted-sensitive-value>istrative name, report kind, approval/rejection options, attachment mode, report types, associated reports, violations, and timestamps. |
| `created_at` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the regulation was created. |

### Example Response

``` json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "01ktw7637mb0zjqq5cbx15setz",
    "name": "asdfasdf",
    "number": "4712258144",
    "issue_date": "2026-05-24 00:00:00",
    "status": true,
    "issuing_authorities": [
      { "value": "commerce", "label": "وزارة التجارة" }
    ],
    "documents": [],
    "items": [...],
    "created_at": "2026-06-11T20:50:08.000000Z"
  }
}

 ```

response.name: Successful Response

# **Get All Inspector Tasks**

Retrieves a list of inspection tasks assigned to the authenticated inspector.

Each task includes workflow information along with the associated inspection visit details such as inspector, location, and metadata.

---

# **Authentication**

This request requires a **Bearer Token**.

The token must be included in the request headers:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

 ```

The token is typically stored in the `{{token}}` environment variable and must be set before sending the request.

---

# **Response Structure**

Returns a JSON array of task objects.

### Top-level field:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| data | array | List of inspection task objects |

---

# **Task Object**

Each object in the `data` array contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | string | Unique identifier of the inspection task |
| number | string | Task reference number |
| workflow | string | Workflow type of the task (e.g. Visit) |
| status | string/object | Current status of the task |
| created_at | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the task was created |
| visit | object | Associated inspection visit details |

---

# **Visit Object**

Each task contains a `visit` object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | string | Unique identifier of the visit |
| type | object | Visit type (value + label enum resource) |
| method | object | Visit method (value + label enum resource) |
| visit_date | string (date) | Scheduled date of the visit |
| facility_name | string | Name of the facility (from plant or license) |
| cr_number | string | Commercial registration number |
| notes | string | Additional notes for the visit |
| third_parties | array | List of third-party entities involved |
| inspector | object |  |
|  |  |  |
|  |  |  |
|  |  |  |
|  |  |  |

request.description:
# **Get Task Details**

Retrieves detailed information about a single inspection task.  
  
This includes workflow metadata and the full inspection visit information such as inspector details, facility data, location, and related documents.

---

# **Authentication**

This request requires a **Bearer Token**.

The token must be included in the request headers:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

 ```

The token is stored in the `{{token}}` environment variable and must be set before sending the request.

---

# **URL Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| task | string | Yes | Unique identifier of the inspection task |

---

# **Response Structure**

Returns a JSON object representing a single task.

### Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | string | Unique identifier of the task |
| number | string | Task reference number |
| workflow | string | Workflow type (e.g. Visit) |
| status | string/object | Current status of the task |
| created_at | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when task was created |
| visit | object | Detailed inspection visit information |

---

# **Visit Object**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | string | Unique identifier of the visit |
| type | object | Visit type (value + label) |
| method | object | Visit method (value + label) |
| visit_date | string (date) | Scheduled visit date |
| facility_name | string | Facility name (plant or license based) |
| cr_number | string | Commercial registration number |
| notes | string | Additional notes |
| third_parties | array | Related third-party entities |
| inspector | object | Assigned inspector details |
| license | object | License details |
| plant | object | Plant details |
| city | object | City details |
| region | object | Region details |
| documents | array | Attached visit documents |

response.name: Successful Response

request.description:
# **Get Plant Production Line**

Retrieves a paginated list of production line items for a specific plant.

The response includes different production types such as products, raw materials, spare parts, and machines, along with their associated plant information and filtered product details.

---

# **Authentication**

This request requires a **Bearer Token**.

The token must be included in the request headers:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

 ```

The token is stored in the `{{token}}` environment variable and must be set before sending the request.

---

# **Request Body Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| plant_id | string/integer | Yes | ID of the plant to fetch production line for | 1 |
| type | string | Yes | Type of production line | product, raw-material, spare-part, machine |
| q | string | No | Search query applied on product fields (hs_code, name_en, name_ar) | FABRICS |
| per_page | integer | No | Number of items per page (min: 1, max: 100) | 10 |

---

# **Production Types**

The `type` field controls which dataset is returned:

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| product | Finished products of the plant |
| raw-material | Raw materials used in production |
| spare-part | Spare parts associated with plant operations |
| machine | Machines used in production |

---

# **Response Structure**

The API returns a **paginated response object**.

### Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| data | array | List of production line items |
| current_page | integer | Current page number |
| last_page | integer | Last page number |
| per_page | integer | Items per page |
| total | integer | Total number of records |

# 📌 Submit Inspection API (Full Documentation)

### Endpoint

```
POST /api/inspection/tasks/submit-inspection/{task}

 ```

---

# 📥 Request Body

## 🔹 inspection_type (enum)

| Value | Label |
| --- | --- |
| onsite | On Site |
| remote | Remote |

---

## 🔹 is_distrupted (boolean)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| true | Inspection was disrupted |
| false | Normal inspection |

---

## 🔹 distrubtion_reason (enum)

Required only if `is_distrupted = true`

| Value | Label |
| --- | --- |
| closed | Closed Factory |
| absent_responsible | Absent Responsible Person |
| wrong_address | Wrong Address |

---

## 🔹 factory_condition (enum)

> <p >Required when NOT disrupted</p> 
  

| Value | Label |
| --- | --- |
| production | Production Running |
| production_stop | Production Stopped |
| not_found | Factory Not Found |
| closed | Closed |
| transfere | Transferred |

---

## 🔹 factory_stop_reason (enum)

> <p >Required when factory_condition is:</p> 
  

- not_found
    
- closed
    
- transfere
    

| Value | Label |
| --- | --- |
| fire | Fire |
| theft | Theft |

---

## 🔹 used_fuel_type (array enum)

| Value | Label |
| --- | --- |
| onsite | Natural Gas |
| diesel | Diesel |
| electricity | Electricity |
| other | Other |

---

# 📦 Full Field Documentation

## 🔹 Inspection Control

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| inspection_type | enum | onsite / remote |
| is_distrupted | boolean | Inspection disruption flag |

---

## 🔹 Disruption Info

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| distrubtion_reason | enum | Reason of disruption |
| other_distrubtion_reason | string | Custom reason |

---

## 🔹 Factory Info

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| factory_condition | enum | Factory status |
| factory_stop_reason | enum | Stop reason if applicable |
| production_date | date | Production date |
| factory_operation_mechanism | string | Operation mechanism |

---

## 🔹 Fuel Types

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| used_fuel_type | array(enum) | Fuel types used |

---

## 🔹 Workforce

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| <redacted-sensitive-value>istrators_number | integer |
| specialized_professions_number | integer |
| technicians_number | integer |
| other_team_number | integer |
| shifts_number | integer |

---

## 🔹 Production

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| production_lines_number | integer |
| licensed_products_number | integer |
| un_licensed_products_number | integer |
| actual_products_number | integer |
| is_exporting | boolean |
| exported_products_number | integer |

---

## 🔹 Selections

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| selected_products | array |
| selected_tools | array |
| selected_raw_materials | array |

---

## 🔹 Equipment

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| tools_and_equipments_number | integer |

---

## 🔹 Compliance

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| is_exmpted | boolean |
| notes | string |

---

## 🔹 Checklist

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| checklist_items | array |
